verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature pages describe a built-in AI assistant, Rovo AI, that users can hand work to. It breaks big ideas into actionable tasks and auto-assigns them, creates custom automations to keep status up to date, surfaces trends and bottlenecks, and connects related assets from Confluence and third-party apps. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how users delegate to Rovo (scope, autonomy, limits), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the delegation works in practice; the evidence is only marketing one-liners.
